pr.body:
Runs every locally-executable live gate of the acceptance matrix against the verified Gate-0C exemplar: live ownership (Tier A), protocol fingerprints, live safe-adapter reads, receipts, and the local negative battery. Remaining NOT_RUN after this packet: vendor/tunnel gates only.

Required PR sections: Objective, Scope, Evidence, Validation, Embedded audit, Risks and unknowns, Rollback, Proof bundle links

steps.task: Enumerate the ACCEPTANCE_MATRIX rows classified 'Deterministic + live' plus the local negative battery; map each to a concrete live test or scripted probe (extend tests/test_live_optional.py where a row lacks coverage); execute against the exemplar set; capture per-row receipts.
requirements: Row-by-row execution table (row id -> test/probe -> PASS/FAIL/NOT_RUN -> receipt path).
Live ownership verification reaches Tier A on the exemplar and BLOCKS on the synthetic heuristic-only candidate.
Cross-repo mount and wrong-project negatives block with correct blocked_reason.
Safe-adapter live reads return enveloped, redacted data from the exemplar backends.
validation: No files outside commit.allowlist are modified; change matches the stated scope.

validation: All executed BLOCKING rows PASS; failures (if any) stop the packet.
